name: Local Structure Example
description:
Adds a small weathered stone shrine to newly generated Overworld terrain. Copy the complete 03_adv_18_local_structure folder into lua_scripts so its manifest, entrypoint, and JSON template stay together.

Explore new chunks and look for a compact cobblestone ruin. Each attempt selects a horizontal rotation and mirror deterministically, palette variants mix cobblestone with mossy cobblestone, and the decay processor removes a few blocks. The template path is derived from the typed structure key.
